textTemplates.name: ContractSentBody
textTemplates.text:
{!GreetingLine_Sent}
I hope you’re having a great week.
I just wanted to let you know that the {!AgreementYearLabel_Sent} has been sent over via DocuSign for your review. Whenever you have a chance, feel free to take a look.
If anything comes up or you’d like to walk through it together, We’re always happy to connect. We’re looking forward to supporting you for the upcoming pool season.
Best, Premier Pool Management Contracts Team

textTemplates.name: Reminder1Body
textTemplates.text:
{!GreetingLine_1}
Just a quick note to make sure the DocuSign agreement came through on your end.
If you didn’t see it or need it resent, I’m happy to take care of that. And of course, let me know if there’s anything you’d like to go over.
Thank you, Premier Pool Management Contracts Team

textTemplates.name: Reminder2Body
textTemplates.text:
{!GreetingLine_2}
I wanted to touch base as we start mapping out staffing and preseason planning for {!ContractSeasonYear_2}. Finalizing the agreement helps us reserve your team and schedule accordingly.
Whenever you have a moment, I’d appreciate an idea of your timeline so we can plan ahead on our side.
Looking forward to working together.
Best, Premier Pool Management Contracts Team

textTemplates.name: Reminder3Body
textTemplates.text:
{!GreetingLine_3}
Just following up on my previous note.
If it would be helpful, I’m glad to schedule a quick meeting to go over anything in the agreement or discuss the upcoming season.
Let me know what works for you.
Thank you, Premier Pool Management Contracts Team
